descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

Acer SA100 240GB SATA III SSD


Specifications:

Capacity: 240GB

Form Factor: 2.5"

Interface: SATA III (6 Gb/s)

NAND Flash: 3D NAND

Sequential Read Speed: Up to 550 MB/s

Sequential Write Speed: Up to 500 MB/s

Operating Voltage: 5 V

Shock Resistance: 1500 G

MTBF: 1.5 Million Hours

Operating Temperature: 0°C – 70°C


Features:

Faster boot and application load times compared to HDD

Low power consumption

Durable and reliable solid-state design

Ideal for laptop and desktop upgrades
